answer: Epoch-Coupled Behavioral Manifold Attestation: each agent’s per-epoch sketch (latency quantiles, tool-call n-gram entropy, error taxonomy, resource bursts) is mapped onto a low-dimensional manifold. At each boundary, the sketch must stay inside a calibrated Mahalanobis band around its prior trajectory across nebula, bridge, and shale task classes; outliers are throttled for three epochs. Sybils must run many identities long-term, each with stable but distinct behavior under randomized workloads—coordination produces correlated drift, raising operational and compute costs.
